transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I just can’t stop feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. Like I’m failing at work, and even at home… like I’m a bad employee and a bad homeowner, and maybe I deserve to lose the things I worked for.
When these thoughts start, do you find it hard to control the worrying?

Yeah. Once I start thinking that way, it’s really hard to stop. I keep going over everything I did wrong, or what I should’ve done, and it turns into this feeling that it’s all my fault—like I’m just failing at work and at home.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different parts of your life, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
I’m not sure. It feels like I worry a lot, but I don’t know if it’s about everything. It mostly seems to land on whatever I think I’m messing up, if that makes sense.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah… I have. I’ve been feeling depressed, and kind of losing interest in things, for a long time now — about two years, maybe a little over. Around two years and a month.
During the past two years, was there ever a stretch of two months or longer when you were not feeling depressed or uninterested in things?

No, I don’t think so. Looking back, it’s been there pretty much the whole time. There were maybe short times where I could get through things a little better, but not like two months where I felt okay or really interested in things again.
Did these depressed feelings start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?

Yeah… I think it did start after a specific change. It was after I bought my townhouse. At first it seemed like a good step, but then the pressure of keeping up with it just started building. Since then, it’s been going on for about two years and three months.
Do your depressed feelings mainly center on the stress of owning and keeping up with the townhouse?
Yeah, mostly. It started after I bought the townhouse, and the pressure of trying to keep up with everything just kept building. It’s been going on about two years and three months now.
During this time, have you often felt worthless or had very low self-esteem?

Yes. I feel worthless a lot. I keep thinking everything that goes wrong is my fault, like I’m failing at work and failing with the townhouse. It makes me feel like I’m a bad employee and a bad homeowner, and like maybe I deserve to lose what I worked for.
Have you had trouble sleeping?

Yes. Most nights I’m lying awake for hours, just listening to the house settling and noises like that. And then I’ll wake up around three or four in the morning and I can’t really get back to sleep before I have to go to work.
Even when you're not dealing with townhouse-related problems, do you still feel depressed?

Yes. Even when nothing specific is happening with the townhouse, I still feel down. Looking back, it’s been there most of the time since all this started. I might have short stretches where I can manage a little better, but the low mood and not really enjoying things don’t really go away.
During this time, was there ever a period of at least two weeks when your depression was especially severe most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes. It’s been pretty constant, honestly. The depression and not being interested in things have been with me for about two years and one month, and there were definitely stretches in there where it felt really severe most of the day, almost every day.
Before this current two-year period, had you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having another period before this that was like that for two weeks straight, but it’s hard to say for certain.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually energetic or high, much more than your normal self?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had times where I had more energy than usual, but not like unusually high or way out of character for me. At least not that I can clearly point to.
Do you worry excessively about many different areas of your life?
I’m not sure I’d say excessively. I worry about things sometimes, like normal life stuff, but I haven’t really noticed it being about lots of different areas all the time.
During this time, have you had a poor appetite or been overeating?

Yeah… my appetite’s been pretty inconsistent. Most days I don’t really eat proper meals during the day. I’ll have coffee, maybe toast, or just whatever’s easiest, and then I notice my clothes are fitting looser.
During those times when the depression felt especially severe, did you have trouble concentrating?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I don’t remember it standing out as a big issue. When I feel really low, it’s harder to get things done, but I can’t say for sure if it was specifically trouble concentrating.
Before this current two-year period, had you ever gone through another episode of depression that lasted at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had periods where I felt down before, but I don’t know if any of them lasted a full two weeks or clearly counted as an episode before this.
During this current two-year period, did you ever have thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself?
I’m not sure. I don’t really have a clear answer for that… I’d have to think about it more.
Before this began, was there ever a time in your life when you felt depressed or lost interest in things nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. Before this, I know I had times where I felt down or kind of disconnected from things, but I can’t really say it was nearly every day for two weeks. I don’t have a clear memory of that.
During this two-year period, was there ever a time when you felt hopeless nearly every day?
I’m not sure. I’ve felt really low at times, but I don’t know if I’d say hopeless nearly every day. I’d have to think about that.
